whenYouDo.text: Target creature you control gets +X/+0 until end of turn, where X is that card's mana value.

abilities.text: Lucky Slots — At the beginning of combat on your turn, scry 1, then exile the top card of your library. You may play that card this turn. When you exile a card this way, target creature you control gets +X/+0 until end of turn, where X is that card's mana value.
